reviews.title: Requested sim card for 6 month
reviews.body:
I have now been trying to get a replacement SIM card from Lebara for approximately SIX MONTHS, and I honestly cannot believe I am still having to chase this.

My phone was lost during a house move and since then I have repeatedly contacted Lebara asking for a replacement SIM for my existing number. Each time I go through the same lengthy chat process, explain the entire situation again, and I am promised that my case will be escalated and dealt with.

Yet again, I was recently assured that this would be escalated and that my SIM card would be sent. Yet again, I have received no SIM card and no contact or update.

This is not a minor inconvenience. This number is connected to my business and social media accounts, where I have around 100,000 followers. I cannot simply change the telephone number associated with some of these accounts, I have had problems resetting passwords and accessing services, and I have been unable to properly receive or respond to business and customer calls.

The amount of time I have wasted trying to resolve something as basic as obtaining a replacement SIM is unbelievable. Each time I contact Lebara, the chat can take one or two hours. On one occasion I spent OVER FOUR HOURS trying to get this sorted.

After six months, I don't understand how a telecommunications company can repeatedly promise to send a replacement SIM and simply fail to do so.

I have been patient, I have explained the circumstances countless times, and I have followed the process Lebara has asked me to follow. Nothing changes.

From now on, I will leave an updated review each time I have to contact Lebara and they fail to resolve this. I want there to be a clear record of how many times I have had to chase them, what I have been promised and whether those promises are actually kept.

I don't need another promise that this has been "escalated". I need the replacement SIM I have been requesting for six months.

reviews.title: I would like to sincerely appreciate…
reviews.body:
I would like to sincerely appreciate the excellent service provided by Lebara. The SIM card and data packages offer good value, with affordable options that are especially helpful for international students.

What impressed me most was the professionalism and respectful communication from the person who contacted me, Krushna Badage. His polite tone and the way he carefully asked about each important requirement made the whole process feel safe and trustworthy. For international students coming to the UK, having this kind of support before travelling can make a big difference.

I also really appreciate the idea of providing students with a SIM card from the biometric stage, allowing them to have connectivity throughout their journey and after arriving in the UK. It shows genuine thought and care towards the safety and convenience of international students.

Krushna was very helpful, respectful, and attentive throughout the process. He made sure that all the necessary information was properly covered and communicated everything clearly.

Overall, I truly appreciate the great service and the effort put into making the experience easier and safer for international students. Keep up the great work, Lebara and Krushna!

reviews.title: A month of chaos, putting vulnerable people in danger, Business Operations Director responded to the last trustpilot review yet they still called the wrong numnber to discuss the complaint???
reviews.body:
Original trustpilot review below, which was responded to by the Business Operation Director. He said someone would be in contact ASAP, but 48 hours later when they called, they again called on the wrong number and not on the number i have provided 3 times, where i am reachable.... Also, i dont think the response from the Business Operations Director actually resulted in any priority? Becuase when i spoke to Lebara a few days ago, when they failed to call in the evening, the advisor said the calls are automated, so they have no control over the number that rings out. I also gave this advisor the correct number to ring but what baffles me is that the nunber they are calling on, is the one with the issue, the one they cannot locate and think they have sent to the new network.....;

A month of chaos, a vulnerable customer cut off from his GP, and not one promise kept. Ref: CAS-2915392-L2V7W8

My family member – an man with limited English who has held his number for decades, we used a STAC instead of a PAC when switching. Mistake on our side, fine. What followed was a month of Lebara failing at every single step:

1) Late August: promised a replacement SIM with number on  so a pac code can be generated by 5th Sept. Never arrived.
2)5 Sept: promised a resolution in 2 days and a call back. Neither happened. Formal complaint opened. Their own Complaints Code promises a response in 3 business days, it has NEVER been answered.
3) 8 Sept: an agent emailed asking why we'd sent a SIM photo their own technical team requested. Then they rang the inactive number. The subject of the complaint  and reported "no answer." We gave an alternative number in writing. They've never once used it.
4) 9 Sept: told us in writing the number had been "ported out to another network," and asked us to confirm this wasn't authorised, promising that on confirmation they would escalate to the relevant team and handle it "as a priority." We confirmed the same day, with video evidence that the number had never left their network at all: the old SIM still registers on Lebara's network and the number rings live. The "priority" handling that followed is everything below.
5) 11 Sept: they admitted they can't reactivate the SIM and said a "specialist team" would contact us. Silence ever since.
6) 13 Sept: a complaints handler rang without reading the case, asked us to explain from scratch, and when I pointed to the case notes, accused ME of being unprofessional and aggressive. He then read the notes, apologised for the position, promised to call the next day on the alternative number but Never called. Oh, he also said, he is speaking to me so he can commence sorting this out? err have they not been working on it so far??
7) 17 Sept: an automated email threatening to CLOSE the case because "we haven't heard from you" while their own email says they owe us the specialist team's update. Same day: asked for a manager, promised a call-back by 11pm. Never came. The advisor couldn't even explain whether an escalation gets logged, then ended the call.
8) 18 Sept: called again. Promised a manager call-back by 11pm, the exact same promise as the day before. For the second night running, nobody called.

That is SIX explicit broken promises, two of them identical, on consecutive days, including a written promise of priority handling.

Meanwhile a man who can't advocate for himself in English is cut off from his GP (who has already tried to call about a medicine review), his employer, and his family abroad who reach him through this number. Every contact restarts from zero. Their own published Complaints Code breached on every clause we've tested.

All we need is a PAC for a number that is still live on their own network. Ofcom's rules require them to provide one on request. A month on, nothing.

Heading to the Communications Ombudsman and reporting to Ofcom. Avoid.

reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service from Naeemuddin
reviews.body:
I am extremely grateful to Naeemuddin for helping me resolve my eSIM transfer and activation issues. His patience, professionalism, knowledge and willingness to genuinely understand the problem were exceptional.

I had been trying to resolve this issue for almost five days and had spoken to multiple Lebara customer service agents, but unfortunately, none were able to properly understand or resolve what was happening. By the time I connected with Naeemuddin, I was already quite frustrated. He, however, approached the issue with remarkable patience and understanding and took the time to work through every aspect of it.

What impressed me most was that he was not only knowledgeable, but also incredibly resourceful. Whenever we encountered a problem, he had another solution to try and never made me feel like the issue was beyond resolution. He remained calm, polite and committed throughout the entire process, and ultimately managed to resolve an issue that I had been struggling with for days.

The level of service I received from Naeemuddin was genuinely outstanding. I honestly wish I had been connected with him during my very first call, as it would have saved me several days of stress and frustration.

He is a real credit to Lebara, and I truly believe his approach to customer service is something other agents could learn from. I sincerely appreciate the time, effort and expertise he put into helping me, and I wish him every success in the future. Thank you, Naeemuddin, for going above and beyond!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.body:
I have previously set out my complaint against Lebara below in relation to their scam / fraudulent approach when dealing with my refund and debiting funds from my account without my authority.

I raised the matter with the Ombudsman as Lebara failed to provide me with a deadlock letter despite making numerous requests for one. The company then sent me a deadlock letter on the last day of the 6 weeks they are permitted to deal with a complaint.

I submitted all my evidence to the Ombudsman and my request for £50 compensation.  Lebara submitted practically nothing in support of their case.

The Ombudsman, having reviewed everything that I had submitted, including dates, times, names of agents that I had spoken to and the audit trail from Trustpilot (thank you Trustpilot) took a matter of days to revert back to me and upheld my complaint. I had asked for £50 compensation but having reviewed everything, the Ombudsman awarded me £75, that's 50% more than I had asked for.

Lebara contacted me on 22 August to ask for my bank details and stated that they were required to give me a refund. I told them that they were ordered to provide compensation and not a refund.

They had 28 days to complete the resolution, namely £75 compensation, letter of apology and evidence to say that they had refunded the money they had taken out of my account without my consent. To date, they have failed to deliver up any of them.

As the decision is legally binding, it now looks like I will have to issue small claims proceedings against Lebara for the money plus further compensation and costs.

I have also asked the Ombudsman to report this matter to Ofcom and Lebara have breached the terms set out by the Ombudsman and have failed to even contact the Ombudsman.
